name: Alsózsolca (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of dark blue over white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Alsózsolca (a blue and white shield with a ploughshare, with a helm, a stag crest and yellow, red and blue mantling) above the name ALSÓZSOLCA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Alsózsolca arms with helm, crest and mantling
